requirement_summary: Enterprise retail platform evaluating Redwood Dedicated + Private hybrid. Must support chat and embeddings at scale with 32k context, predictable reserved GPU planning for holiday spikes, strict security (SOC2, SSO, KMS), and quantization-aware tuning to control unit economics without breaking QA thresholds.
technical_requirements: Latency SLO: P95 chat <= 150ms; P99 < 300ms for 1k token sessions
Throughput SLO: sustained 300 qps chat baseline, up to 800 qps burst across services (chat+embeddings+routing)
Context length: production sessions must support 32k tokens; fallbacks down to 8k for cost-sensitive routes
Quantization profile: evaluate FP16, int8, and 4-bit (q4 variants); measure quality delta on standardized prompt set
Batching strategy: dynamic batching with target batch size 8-16; prefer latency-aware batching boundaries for interactive flows
KV cache policy: per-session KV with 30m TTL, sticky to reserved GPU pool when possible; automatic cache warming for repeat prompts
Hardware targets: benchmark on A100-80GB and H100-80GB; reserved capacity proposal to include node/capacity map and autoscaling burst policy
Resilience: defined fallback model mapping and routing policy for capacity oversubscription; automatic graceful degradation within SLA bounds
acceptance_criteria: 2-week dedicated POC demonstrates sustained P95 <= 150ms at 70% of forecasted peak load
Quantization validation shows <= 3% quality delta on NLU metrics for customer-critical prompts when using q4 profile
Security checklist completed: SSO integration test, KMS key import, audit log ingestion in Splunk staging
Operations runbook delivered: autoscaling triggers, fallback routing rules, incident escalation path
Commercial: draft SOW with reserved GPU pricing and step-down SLA reviewed by procurement
